title: Spill envelope is unreachable for remote MCP clients: spilled_to is a daemon-local path
wanted_capability: The over-cap spill envelope (spilled_to pointing into <state_dir>/response-dumps/) assumes the MCP client shares a filesystem with the daemon. For remote clients (macOS control-plane host talking to the cage daemon over HTTP MCP) the path is unreachable, so an over-cap response is not lossless, it is effectively lost: the client gets a preview plus a pointer it cannot dereference. Wanted: a wire-level retrieval path for spilled payloads, e.g. a bbox tool or HTTP route that fetches a spill by id with offset/limit chunking (each chunk under the response cap), or client-locality detection that falls back to paginated delivery instead of a local path. The spill id is already in the envelope; only the dereference primitive is missing.
missing_primitive: Remote dereference for response-dump spill files (fetch-by-id with chunking) or locality-aware spill delivery
fallback_used: Re-issued the query in a narrower form (bro_brofile get by name instead of list) to stay under the cap; brofile survey questions stay unanswerable remotely.
evidence: bro_brofile(action=list) -> 91,116 bytes spilled to /var/lib/blackbox/state/response-dumps/resp-1787210381708-de5bfe63ed50dca3.json, unreachable from the macOS MCP client (2026-08-20)
umbrella gap-ecff3899 (mcp_surface/response-cap/per-tool-oversized-producers) treats spill as lossless recovery, which only holds for colocated clients
notes: Filed at operator direction mid-session. The spill mechanism's losslessness claim silently depends on filesystem colocation; every remote-client over-cap response is a hard data loss today. Producer-side shaping (gap-ecff3899) reduces frequency but the dereference primitive is still missing for the residual cases.
resolution_note: Replaced accidental server spill with an 80KiB whole-envelope guard in 8ccdcd06; server creates no dump files or filesystem recovery hints. Oversized responses now carry typed error.response_too_large and MCP isError=true, with producer-specific narrowing advice. Deployed image 4ffe9430f0e3; live oversized invalid inspection produced an 897-byte error without spilled_to. Producer shaping and intentional continuations continue under the broader MCP audit.
